Your impact begins here

As Sr AI Process Designer in Rapid Enablement, you will help business areas across Novo rethink how work gets done with AI, rather than simply applying AI to what already exists. You will join cross-functional engagements that take an opportunity from an initial request to an evidence-based decision about what happens next. By designing future-state services around what AI and people each do well, and testing them with real users, you help the right ideas move forward fast.

What you’ll bring

You are proactive and structured, able to frame ambiguous problems independently, challenge an initial solution request constructively, and test a better future state under time pressure. You bring most of the following:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in service design, interaction design, human-computer interaction or a related field.

• 4+ years of experience applying service design, human-centred design or closely related methods to complex services or business processes, including researching and mapping end-to-end processes across multiple actors, systems, channels and organisational boundaries.

• Strong facilitation experience, including online and in-person creative workshops and co-design sessions with senior, multidisciplinary stakeholders.

• The ability to turn research and operational evidence into clear design opportunities and future-state services, and to prototype and test concepts iteratively rather than relying only on analysis and documentation.

• Excellent visual and verbal communication skills: you make complex processes understandable to non-design and technical audiences, and challenge existing ways of working with confidence.

• A pragmatic mindset: good today is better than perfect tomorrow. You balance great user experiences with project constraints.

• Strong planning and project management skills, with the ability to own larger deliverables independently and translate strategy into ambitious, testable goals.

• Comfort working at pace with incomplete information, and strong collaboration skills with business subject-matter experts, software engineers and AI specialists.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience redesigning knowledge-work or enterprise business processes.

• AI-enabled service or workflow design, including human-in-the-loop patterns.

• Experience in enterprise transformation, internal consulting, or regulated and highly complex organisations.

• Designing services that span digital and non-digital interactions.

• Experience with experimentation, rapid prototyping and discovery methods, and connecting design decisions to measurable business value.

Deep AI expertise is not required. You do need to understand the possibilities and limitations of AI well enough to design effectively alongside technical colleagues.

What you’ll do

You will work in short iterations and test the riskiest unknowns first, making quick progress while reducing risk. You will facilitate the process from start to finish, bring others along without formal authority, and share findings so decision makers can act.

• Plan and facilitate workshops and co-design sessions with business and technical stakeholders to understand real users’ pain points, surface risky assumptions behind AI-driven ideas, and build shared understanding of the problem, target outcome and success criteria.

• Identify where AI, automation or human judgement can materially improve a workflow, and design future-state services rather than digitising the current state.

• Work with team members and stakeholders to make hypotheses concrete through journey maps, service blueprints and prototypes.

• Test concepts with users and stakeholders, use the evidence to iterate, and help decide whether to proceed, change direction or stop.

• Capture rationale and evidence so a receiving team can continue the work after Rapid Enablement exits.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Rapid Enablement, a new and growing team within AI Employee Experience & Enablement, part of Enterprise AI in Enterprise IT & Quality. The team exists to rapidly accelerate high-value AI opportunities across the Novo value chain, from idea to an evidence-based proof of value, and to build reusable enterprise productivity agents.

In cross-functional engagements, you will work with business stakeholders, process owners, engineers and AI specialists. Together you will move from a first request to a clear decision on what should happen next, with a direct effect on how AI improves workflows and is adopted across Novo.

What you can expect here

You will work at the leading edge of how Novo turns AI ambition into proven, adopted solutions, with your design judgement directly shaping which opportunities move forward. You will operate independently on ambiguous, high-value problems and receive guidance mainly on the most complex issues.

Each engagement touches a different part of the value chain, so you will build new skills and broaden your view of the business while contributing your expertise from day one. Your work supports our shared goal of reaching millions of people living with serious chronic diseases and creating lasting health.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build software that helps scientists work with complex data, predictive models and modern engineering solutions. You will turn scientific ideas and algorithms into robust software, while helping simplify and improve a rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Working at the intersection of software engineering, data and science, you will collaborate closely with scientists, modellers, data scientists and fellow engineers. Your ability to listen, learn and translate between technical and scientific perspectives will be just as important as your coding expertise.

What you'll bring

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and is curious about working in a scientific environment. You bring an open mindset and are eager to learn from colleagues with different areas of expertise.

• 
A bachelor's, master's degree, PhD or similar qualification in computer science, mathematics, engineering, statistics, Information Technology specialised within AI/ML, data and analytics, or a related field

• 
At least 3 years of professional experience working in software engineering teams, outside solely academic experience

• 
Significant professional experience with Python and at least basic familiarity with NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch and PySpark

• 
Working knowledge of data structures, algorithms and modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, containerisation and testing

• 
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and scientific colleagues

• 
Experience with AWS, cloud engineering, Infrastructure as Code, distributed systems, orchestration, visualisation, data analysis, biology or chemistry would be an advantage

What you'll do

• 
Develop and deploy backend software supporting scientists, including automation for data products and MLOps for predictive models

• 
Work closely with engineers and subject matter experts to translate scientific needs into maintainable software solutions

• 
Develop efficient implementations of algorithms from scientific literature and apply sound software engineering principles to simplify a complex technology stack

• 
Maintain a high level of technical quality by contributing actively to code reviews, testing and architectural discussions

Coordinate your work with the team in an agile way and regularly present your work to colleagues and stakeholders

• 
Explore new libraries and technologies, evaluate dependencies and continuously strengthen your technical and scientific understanding

Who you'll work with

Clear, respectful communication across professional and cultural backgrounds is an important part of the role.

As Lead AI Engineer, you will be the senior technical authority in Rapid Enablement's SWAT engagements: time-boxed, cross-functional sprints that take a business area's AI opportunity from idea to a clear, evidence-based decision on what happens next. You will build what it takes to prove or disprove value and feasibility within a fixed timebox, and lead the reusable enterprise agents the team will own. Your work shows Novo where AI can make a real difference, faster.

What you’ll bring

You are equally comfortable being the technical authority in the room and getting hands-on to prove an idea fast. Depending on your experience, you will bring:

• A strong track record of taking AI-centric applications from idea to a working solution across code first and low-code/no-code platforms.

• hands-on experience with modern AI engineering: LLMs, agents, evaluation frameworks, vector databases and semantic search, and related tooling.

• Functional knowledge of modern AI standards (MCP, A2A, Agent Skills, OpenTelemetry or similar) and agentic IDE tooling (VSC, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or similar).

• Experience setting technical direction or standards for other engineers, and mentoring less senior colleagues.

• The ability to work directly and confidently with senior business stakeholders, turning ambiguous problems into a scoped, testable technical approach under time pressure.

• Fluency with modern software development practices, including CI/CD and Git.

• A rapid prototyping instinct and a high degree of innovation: you quickly turn complex problems into testable solutions.

• An MSc, PhD or similar graduate degree in engineering, computer science, data science or a related field, or equivalent depth of experience.

What you’ll do

You will lead the technical work that helps business areas decide, with evidence, whether an AI opportunity is worth scaling.

• Act as the senior hands-on engineer in SWAT engagements, architecting and building the technical solution needed to prove or disprove an opportunity's value and feasibility within a fixed timebox.

• Set technical direction and standards across engagements, including architecture choices, AI patterns and evaluation approaches that hold up under real business stakeholder scrutiny.

• Work closely with the team's AI Process designers to turn a redesigned business process into a working, testable technical solution.

• Lead the solutioning and technical implementation of reusable enterprise agents that Rapid Enablement keeps standing operational ownership of.

• Mentor and pair with less senior engineers, so technical quality holds even when engagements run at pace.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Rapid Enablement, part of AI Employee Experience & Enablement within Enterprise AI. The team exists to rapidly accelerate high-value AI opportunities across the Novo value chain, from idea to evidence-based proof of value, and to build reusable enterprise productivity agents. It is a dynamic and growing team, and its cross-functional engagements have a direct impact on how AI gets adopted across Novo.

Day to day, you will work with the team's AI Process designers, with senior and junior engineers you mentor and pair with, and with senior business stakeholders from the business areas you support. When an engagement needs specialised competences, you will collaborate with technical peers from other Enterprise AI teams. The work is cloud-native and runs across Novo's internal platforms, including Databricks, Snowflake, ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot Studio, spanning both no-code and code-first approaches.

Your team will be part of Enterprise AI, working closely with colleagues across the business to understand their needs and support our shared goal of reaching millions of people living with serious chronic diseases and creating lasting health.

What you can expect here

Every engagement takes you into a different part of the Novo value chain, so you will keep building new skills and broaden your view of where AI creates value. You will grow alongside colleagues on the job and be part of Novo's work to upskill its workforce in AI and technology. You will be trusted to own technical decisions and make your voice heard, and you will be supported to perform at your best.

Your impact begins here

As Laboratory Technician in Research Bioanalysis, you will help early-stage research projects get the answers they need. You will develop and run immunoassays that measure proteins and peptides in biological samples, giving project teams data to predict how long new compounds stay in circulation and how they work in the body. Your work supports early research in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular diseases.

What you’ll bring

• A relevant education in laboratory technology or equivalent.

• Proficiency in general biological research laboratory techniques and workflows.

• Practical experience analysing biological samples.

• A keen interest in data analysis and a drive to keep data quality high.

• A flair for IT and laboratory instruments, with the willingness to learn and adapt.

• A proactive attitude towards building your analytical technical skills, with an open mindset.

• An energetic, self-driven and organised way of working, and a team-player mindset.

• Hands-on experience with immunoassays such as ELISA, MSD or AlphaLISA.

What you’ll do

New projects often call for new ways of measuring different proteins and peptides. You will spend a significant part of your time developing tailored methods, alongside analysing samples with established ones.

• Develop and implement new immunoassays for the proteins and peptides your collaborators need to measure.

• Analyse samples from in vivo and in vitro studies using immunoassays

• Plan and carry out sample analyses, using robotics and IT systems to handle samples efficiently and track data.

• Analyse data and safeguard data integrity, so project teams can rely on the results.

• Proactively improve laboratory workflows and integrate new digital tools and AI

• Help strengthen the culture of the department.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Research Bioanalysis, part of Therapeutic Discovery within Research & Development, in Måløv, Denmark. In Research & Development, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing. Curiosity, data, technology and collaboration come together to help meet future health needs.

Your team is high-achieving, multidisciplinary and international: seven laboratory technicians, one tech trainee, four associate scientists and eight scientists. You will also work with collaborators who provide the samples and rely on your data, and with colleagues in other departments as workflows are refined across the research process.

What you can expect here

You will work in a department that is putting automation, digital tools and AI to use in everyday analytical work. You will have room to build new technical skills, take ownership of method development and make your voice heard on how the work is done. You will be supported to perform at your best by colleagues who share their expertise.

Ballerup, Denmark

As Senior AI Engineer in Enterprise AI, you will turn strategic AI use cases into reliable products that create value across Novo. Working in cross-functional product teams in areas such as Commercial and Manufacturing & Product Supply, you will decide what each problem really needs, from conventional software to retrieval-grounded GenAI, and take it from prototype to production. Your work helps bring AI into everyday use for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You enjoy turning technology into business impact. You don’t need deep expertise in every part of AI engineering, but you do have a solid foundation in software delivery, production AI and cross-functional product work.

• 4+ years of experience building AI or software products. Demonstrated scope and capability matter more than tenure alone.

• Own substantial delivery workstreams, shape technical and product choices, and support less experienced engineers.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the AI Engineering Solutions team within AI Reinvent & Engineering, part of Enterprise AI in Enterprise IT, based in Ballerup, Denmark. The team brings together engineers with different strengths across statistics, machine learning, AI and software engineering.

Day to day, you will often work in product teams in Commercial, Manufacturing & Product Supply and other business areas, alongside product managers, domain experts, data scientists and engineers. Staying close to the problems keeps the work relevant, while links to the AI Foundation team keep engineering practices shared. We are cloud-native, working across Azure and AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, foundation-model APIs and modern AI application frameworks, and we value technical rigour, direct feedback and continuous learning.

What you can expect here

You will work in a multinational environment where your expertise is valued and trusted. You will keep growing through continuous learning and hands-on experience across business areas, with room to shape technical and product choices and to support colleagues as they develop.

jobs.occupation: Senior Contract Management Specialist (Senior Contract Counsel)
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes
